title: Process Context via manual event subscriber pattern
summary: Adds community knowledge article documenting how to expose process context to extensions using manual event subscriber bindings tied to variable scope instead of singleton flags that persist across failed transactions.
key_points: A SingleInstance boolean is unsafe because it sits outside the transaction and stays true after a failed run
Recommended shape: a public query procedure backed by a local InternalEvent
The event is answered by an internal flag codeunit with manual subscriber instance, bound only for the run
Binding lifetime follows variable scope, so an error unwinds it; BindSubscription without UnbindSubscription is intended
Includes good and bad samples; inspired by the ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL DE context logic
quote: A manual binding is the safe carrier: its lifetime is tied to a variable's scope
